nodes.label: LocalDateType and Buenos Aires TZ
nodes.rationale: MikroORM writes Dates in UTC, so a date assigned after 21h would land on the next day.

nodes.label: Versioned prices (ParkingPrice, ServicePrice)
nodes.rationale: Never edited in place; expire current and create new so invoices keep history (R-14).

nodes.label: User roles and protected registration
nodes.rationale: Public registration only allows CLIENTE or DUEÑO; admin is seeded with Argon2 hash.

nodes.label: PLATE_REGEX (Argentine plates)
nodes.rationale: Must stay in sync with Frontend utils/plate.ts.

nodes.label: In-app notifications (NotificationService.notify never throws)
nodes.rationale: A failed notice must not revert the action; repository uses em.fork() because timers run without RequestContext.

nodes.label: Atomic writes with em.transactional and lockParking

nodes.label: JWT authentication (auth/self middlewares)
nodes.rationale: auth reads the user from DB and requires ACTIVO so a deactivation or role change cuts access immediately; admin is not a wildcard (RA-19).

nodes.rationale: Safe schema update never drops tables or columns; renames/removals need manual SQL.

nodes.norm_label: ownership middlewares (l-37: ownparking, parkingof, ownvehicle, ownreservation, staffofinvoice)

nodes.label: Local tsx tests policy (_test DBs, not versioned)
nodes.norm_label: local tsx tests policy (_test dbs, not versioned)

nodes.label: Kanban methodology (Notion board, branch per feature)

nodes.label: Centralized error handling (catchAsync, AppError, errorHandler)
nodes.rationale: Avoid repetitive try/catch; map AppError and DB unique violations (409); hide stacktrace in production.
